title: Tensor and sheafification for modules over a presheaf of rings
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,J)$ be a site, let $\mathcal O$ be a presheaf [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of commutative rings, let $\mathcal P$ be a presheaf [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] of $\mathcal O$-modules, and let $\mathcal G$ be a sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] of $\mathcal O^\#$-modules, regarded as a presheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules by restriction of scalars along $\mathcal O\to\mathcal O^\#$. There is a canonical natural isomorphism of sheaves of $\mathcal O^\#$-modules: $\mathcal G\otimes_{\mathcal O^\#}\mathcal P^\#\cong(\mathcal G\otimes_{p,\mathcal O}\mathcal P)^\#$, where the right side is the module sheafification and $\mathcal G\cong\mathcal G^\#$ is used for the sheaf factor.
